changelog: Voice numbered lists — say "number one" to "number ten" alone while dictating (or "নম্বর এক" to "নম্বর দশ") and a new line with the number starts, so an order list can be dictated step by step; with Spoken punctuation ON, the same phrases also work mid-sentence — e.g. "items number one rice number two dal" puts 1. rice and 2. dal on new lines (১. ২. in Bangla). The item after the number is capitalized automatically. Nothing else changed — it never sends a message or deletes text you typed.
